Sandbox_MinWellWaterPerCycle_tooltip: The minimum amount of water (in units) the well will produce per refill cycle.
Sandbox_MaxWellWaterPerCycle_tooltip: The maximum amount of water (in units) the well will produce per refill cycle.
Sandbox_WellWaterPerCycleMultiplier_tool: Multiplier applied to the water refill rate of the well. Higher values increase the total water generated per cycle.
Sandbox_WellMinBetweenDistanceToFullRefi: Min Distance Between Wells to Refill
Minimum distance (in tiles) required between wells in order for them to fully refill. Prevents clustering multiple wells too close together for resource gain.
Sandbox_AllowUndergroundWell_tooltip: If enabled, players can build/place wells in underground. Disable to restrict well placement to ground level.
Sandbox_CanWellBeContaminated_tooltip: If enabled, wells can become contaminated if there are dead bodies nearby, making the water unsafe to drink. This adds a layer of risk to well placement and maintenance.
Sandbox_WellDeadBodiesRadius_tooltip: The radius (in tiles) around a well within which dead bodies can contaminate the water.
Sandbox_MinHoursWithBodiesToContaminate: Minimum Hours with Bodies to Contaminate
Sandbox_MinHoursWithBodiesToContaminate_: The minimum number of hours that dead bodies need to be present within the contamination radius of a well in order for it to become contaminated.
Sandbox_ContaminationChancePerBody_toolt: The chance (as a percentage) that each dead body within the contamination radius will contribute to contaminating the well.
Sandbox_CharcoalNeededPerLiter_tooltip: The amount of charcoal needed to clean one liter of water from the well. Higher values require more charcoal for cleaning water.
